conversation_starters.title: Twin Cities gas prices hit $4/gallon, up 16 cents in one week
conversation_starters.summary: Drivers across the Twin Cities, the Minneapolis-St. Paul metro area, are feeling the pinch as average gasoline prices have surged past $4 per gallon, fueled by global supply disruptions and refinery issues.

you_should_know.title: Judge lifts pause, allowing end to Temporary Protected Status for Somalia
you_should_know.summary: A federal judge in Massachusetts has lifted the pause that was protecting Somali Temporary Protected Status holders, many of whom live in the Minneapolis-St. Paul area, home to the largest Somali community in the United States.

you_should_know.title: Court rules against Trump administration lawsuit over Minnesota voter rolls
